title: 字符串解码
statement: 给定一个经过编码的字符串 s，编码规则为 k[encoded_string]：方括号内的子串重复恰好 k 次（k 为正整数），编码可以嵌套。输入保证合法：括号成对、没有多余空格、原始数据中不含数字（数字只作为重复次数出现）。返回解码后的字符串。

en.title: Decode String
en.statement: Given an encoded string s, where the encoding rule is k[encoded_string]: the substring inside the brackets is repeated exactly k times (k is a positive integer), and encodings may be nested. The input is guaranteed to be valid: brackets are balanced, there are no extra spaces, and the original data contains no digits (digits appear only as repeat counts). Return the decoded string.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters, digits and square brackets '[]', and is guaranteed to be a valid encoding
All integers in s are in the range [1, 300]
The decoded result has length at most 10^5

complexity.time: O(L) (L is the length of the decoded result; each output character is built a constant number of times; implementations that concatenate at each nesting level may incur extra copying proportional to nesting depth)
complexity.space: O(L) (the result and partial strings on the stack); the recursive solution also uses an O(|s|) recursion stack
complexity.notes: |s| is the encoded string length (≤ 30) and L is the output length (≤ 10^5). Use two stacks, one for repeat counts and one for the prefix built before entering the bracket; on ']', repeat the current string k times and append it to the prefix. The largest local test outputs exactly 10^5 characters.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: one line with the encoded string s. stdout: one line, the decoded string.

constraints: s 由小写英文字母、数字和方括号 '[]' 组成，且保证是合法编码
s 中所有整数取值范围为 [1, 300]

complexity.time: O(L)（L 为解码结果长度，每个输出字符被构造常数次；嵌套拼接的实现可能多出与嵌套深度相关的拷贝）
complexity.space: O(L)（结果与栈中的部分串）；递归解法另含 O(|s|) 递归栈
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: |s| 为编码串长度（≤ 30），L 为输出长度（≤ 10^5）。用两个栈分别保存重复次数和进入括号前已构造的前缀；遇到 ']' 时把当前串重复 k 次接到前缀后。本地最大测试输出恰为 10^5 个字符。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：一行编码字符串 s。stdout：一行，解码后的字符串。
